ios.desc:
**QuikAnimate makes animation fast, fun, and easy.**  
Create scroll-stopping videos with sprites, text, emojis, and music—no steep learning curve required.

Design with touch-first controls: pinch to scale, rotate with two fingers, drag to position, and record motion in real time. From quick social clips to polished explainers, QuikAnimate helps you turn ideas into shareable videos in minutes.

**Why creators love QuikAnimate**
• Direct multi-sprite animation with independent control  
• Frame-by-frame editing up to 24 FPS  
• Real-time reactive recording for natural motion  
• Advanced transforms: position, rotation, scale, and layer order  
• Undo/redo for worry-free experimentation  
• Group selection to animate multiple elements together

**Built for every platform**
• 16:9 (YouTube)  
• 9:16 (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)  
• 1:1 (square posts)

**More powerful tools**
• Precise timeline scrubber for frame-perfect edits  
• Drag-and-drop Z-order layer management  
• Audio import support: MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC  
• Save and load projects anytime  
• Theater mode for distraction-free playback

Perfect for animated stories, social content, product demos, and explainer videos.

**Start creating with QuikAnimate today—where creativity meets simplicity.**
